entries.title: Sealed-bid auction with a public reserve price

params.name: reserve
params.label: Reserve price
params.help: The lowest bid the seller accepts. Bids below it are ignored.

params.name: rule
params.label: Pricing rule
params.help: What the winner pays: their own bid, or the highest other bid (at least the reserve).

params.name: reveal_bids
params.label: Publish all bids afterwards
params.help: Whether every bidder is told all bids after the auction.

casts.name: truthful
casts.label: Everyone bids their value
casts.description: Each bidder bids exactly what the item is worth to them.

casts.name: shading
casts.label: Everyone bids 80% of their value
casts.description: Each bidder shades their bid to 80% of their value.

params.name: rounds
params.label: Number of rounds
params.help: How many times each pair plays.

params.name: matching
params.label: Who plays whom
params.help: The same partner every round, or a new partner each round.

casts.name: cooperators
casts.label: Everyone always cooperates
casts.description: Both players of every pair cooperate in every round.

casts.name: defectors
casts.label: Everyone always defects
casts.description: Both players of every pair defect in every round.

casts.name: tit-for-tat
casts.label: Everyone plays tit for tat
casts.description: Cooperate first, then copy what the partner did last round.

casts.name: tit-for-tat-vs-defector
casts.label: Tit for tat against a defector
casts.description: The first player of each pair plays tit for tat; the second always defects.

entries.title: Carbon credit market with paid verifiers and audits

params.name: rounds
params.label: Number of rounds
params.help: How many times verification, trading and auditing repeat.

params.name: p_audit
params.label: Audit probability
params.help: The chance that a verified project is audited in a round.

params.name: penalty
params.label: Penalty for a caught verifier
params.help: What a verifier pays when an audit finds its report too far from the truth.

params.name: fee
params.label: Verification fee
params.help: What a verifier is paid per project it verifies.

params.name: reputation_visible
params.label: Buyers see verifiers' track records
params.help: Whether buyers are shown each verifier's past audit results.

params.name: settle_on
params.label: Credits are paid on
params.help: Whether sellers are paid for the reported quality or the true quality.

casts.name: naive-buyers
casts.label: Buyers trust the reports
casts.description: Verifiers report what they measured, sellers offer at cost, buyers take every reported quality at face value.

casts.name: skeptical-buyers
casts.label: Buyers discount by track record
casts.description: As before, but buyers subtract each verifier's past over-statement when it is shown.
